P.text: When isClaimed == false, AtomWallet.owner() delegates ownership to multiVault.getAtomWarden(), an external call to MultiVault; owner() is invoked from _validateSignature during the ERC-4337 validation phase.
P.evidence_quote: When `isClaimed == false`, ownership is delegated to `multiVault.getAtomWarden()` — an external call to the `MultiVault` contract. `owner()` is invoked from `_validateSignature` at the point where the recovered signer is compared against the expected owner

I.text: ERC-7562 rules STO-021/STO-022 permit reading storage in an external contract during validation only when the accessed slot is associated with the account, meaning the slot's value equals the account address or the slot was derived as keccak(A || x) + n.
I.evidence_quote: Rules **[STO-021]** and **[STO-022]** permit reading storage in an external contract only when the accessed slot is **associated** with the account.

V.text: multiVault.getAtomWarden() reads walletConfig.atomWarden, a plain struct field holding the warden address not the AtomWallet address and not derived from keccak(atomWalletAddress || ...), so the storage is not associated with the calling AtomWallet; this violates STO-021/STO-022 and compliant bundlers reject UserOps for all unclaimed wallets.
V.evidence_quote: It therefore does not meet either condition: the accessed storage is **not associated** with the calling `AtomWallet`. Accessing it from within `validateUserOp` violates `STO-021`/`STO-022`.
